name: Hoang Van Nguyen

attribution.legal_posture: Vietnam-based bank-account and cryptocurrency facilitator; this is an administrative sanctions designation, with no criminal charge or conviction on record.

locations: Vietnam (OFAC-listed country; not a present-location inference)
caveats: OFAC's designation is an administrative action; this record carries no criminal charge or conviction. Vietnam is source-listed country context as of the cited sanctions records; current residence, presence, and activity require separate sources, and account, wallet, and transaction selectors are excluded from the public record.

sources.support: Treasury reports that Hoang Van Nguyen assisted Kim Se Un in opening bank accounts and enabling cryptocurrency transactions, worked with Kim to procure foreign currency, and in 2022 facilitated a counterfeit-cigarette deal exceeding $200,000 on Kim's behalf. These are administrative-source assessments, not adjudicated findings, and no account, wallet, or transaction selector is retained

identity_boundary: Hoang Van Nguyen, listed by OFAC as HOANG, Van Nguyen and referenced by Treasury as Hoang, is the person Treasury reported as assisting sanctioned DPRK procurement facilitator Kim Se Un with bank-account, cryptocurrency, foreign-currency, and a 2022 counterfeit-cigarette transaction. Preserve those administrative-source allegations and designation posture; criminal guilt, present location, account or wallet control, and same-named-public-account identity remain unresolved.
